name: Telemetry and error reporting
purpose: Emits journey checkpoint events, error-boundary reports, and performance marks per spa-REQ-016 under the naming scheme in ADR-209-spa-telemetry-naming.
responsibilities: Expose a typed emit API for journey checkpoint events; free-text event names are not accepted.
Install error boundaries at the shell and route level and report catches with route, component, and session context, redacting personal data.
Record performance marks at first paint and time-to-interactive and forward them with the declared names.
Buffer events during offline periods and flush on reconnect, bounded, dropping oldest-first beyond the bound.
No-op cleanly when the project deploys without a telemetry backend; instrumentation must not break the application.
tradeoffs: A typed event API costs a registry file per journey and buys dashboards that survive refactors.
